```plato
    //==
    // # Arcs and conic pieces

    // The point at the swept angle on the circle of radius Radius about Center.
    Eval(self: CircularArc2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.Center + self.Angles.Lerp(t).CirclePoint(self.Radius);
```

```plato
    // The point at the swept parametric angle on the ellipse: the axis-aligned
    // point (a cos theta, b sin theta) tilted by Rotation and placed at Center.
    Eval(self: EllipticalArc2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.Center
         + Vector2D(self.Radii.X * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos,
                    self.Radii.Y * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin).RotateBy(self.Rotation);
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Function graphs

    // The point (x, Scale * cosh(x / Scale)) with x swept over Domain. The
    // hyperbolic cosine is only declared on Angle, so the ratio is cast with
    // the radians constructor before Cosh.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catenary
    Eval(self: Catenary2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => (self.Domain.Lerp(t),
                   self.Scale * (self.Domain.Lerp(t) / self.Scale).Angle.Cosh);
```

```plato
    // The point (x, Amplitude * sin(2*pi*x/Wavelength + Phase)) with x swept
    // over Domain. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sine_wave
    Eval(self: SineCurve2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => (self.Domain.Lerp(t),
                   self.Amplitude
                   * ((self.Domain.Lerp(t) / self.Wavelength).Turns + self.Phase).Sin);
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Polynomial arcs
    //

    // The Bernstein forms live in `library Polynomials` (polynomials.types.plato),
    // generic over `INumerical`; control points are converted to displacements
    // with PositionVector and the result back with ToPoint.

    // The quadratic Bezier point at t.
    Eval(self: QuadraticBezier2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.P0.PositionVector
               .QuadraticBezier(self.P1.PositionVector, self.P2.PositionVector, t)
               .ToPoint;
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Evaluating the polar and figure curves
    //
    // Closed-form evaluation of the types declared in `curves-shapes.types.plato`, plus
    // the generic `IPolarCurve2D` bridge that turns a `RadiusAt` into a position for
    // every polar implementor in the tree. The shared `CirclePoint` helper is in
    // the arcs section above.
    //
    // Conventions:
    //   * The canonical curve parameter is `t` in [0, 1] (the `IProcedural` domain
    //     inherited through `ICurve2D`).
    //   * `IPolarCurve2D` implementors only need `RadiusAt`. The generic
    //     `Eval(IPolarCurve2D, Number)` below turns that into a position, so the
    //     polar zoo costs one line per curve.

    //==
    // # IPolarCurve2D — the generic bridge
    //
    // A polar curve is fully determined by RadiusAt, so its Eval is derivable
    // once for every implementor. Curves that carry an explicit `Angles` sweep
    // override this with their own Eval below.

    // The position at the canonical parameter t: the polar radius taken at
    // t full turns, converted to Cartesian.
    Eval(self: IPolarCurve2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.CartesianPositionAt(t.Turns);
```

```plato
    // r = sqrt(Scale^2 * cos(2 theta)), over one full turn. The radius is
    // imaginary on the quadrants where cos(2 theta) is negative; those
    // parameters lie off the real curve.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lemniscate_of_Bernoulli
    Eval(self: Lemniscate2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => t.Turns.CirclePoint((self.Scale.Square * (t.Turns * 2.0).Cos).Sqrt).ToPoint;
```

```plato
    // `Eval(Clothoid2D, Number)` is at the foot of the spirals section. It sidesteps both
    // of the blockers the old TODO here recorded: quadrature of the tangent
    // angle replaces the truncated Maclaurin series that degraded over real
    // arc-length spans, and there is no guessed scaling because the type's own
    // doc comment pins the argument — curvature is s / Flatness^2 and the
    // parameter IS signed arc length, so the tangent angle is s^2 / (2
    // Flatness^2) and nothing is left to choose.

    // The involute of a circle: x = R(cos theta + theta sin theta),
    // y = R(sin theta - theta cos theta), theta in radians.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Involute
    Eval(self: CircleInvolute2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => (self.Radius * (self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos
                                  + self.Angles.Lerp(t).Radians * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin),
                   self.Radius * (self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin
                                  - self.Angles.Lerp(t).Radians * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos));
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Roulettes (rolling-circle curves)

    // x = R(theta - sin theta), y = R(1 - cos theta), theta in radians.

    Eval(self: Cycloid2D, t: Number): Point2D

                   self.Radius * (1.0 - self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos));
```

```plato
    // x = (R+r)cos t - r cos((R+r)/r t); y = (R+r)sin t - r sin((R+r)/r t).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epicycloid
    Eval(self: Epicycloid2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => (t.Turns.CirclePoint(self.FixedRadius + self.RollingRadius)
            - ((self.FixedRadius + self.RollingRadius) / self.RollingRadius * t.Turns)
                  .CirclePoint(self.RollingRadius))
           .ToPoint;
```

```plato
    // x = (R-r)cos t + r cos((R-r)/r t); y = (R-r)sin t - r sin((R-r)/r t).

    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypocycloid
    Eval(self: Hypocycloid2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => ((self.FixedRadius - self.RollingRadius) * t.Turns.Cos

                        * t.Turns).Cos,
                   (self.FixedRadius - self.RollingRadius) * t.Turns.Sin

                     * ((self.FixedRadius - self.RollingRadius) / self.RollingRadius
                        * t.Turns).Sin);
```

## Line 375

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/curves-shapes.library.plato, line 375](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/curves-shapes.library.plato#L375).

```plato

    // The point at the given unit parameter: the Fresnel integrals evaluated to
    // the arc length that parameter names within Domain.
    Eval(self: Clothoid2D, t: Number): Point2D {
        var panels = self.QuadraturePanels;
        var s = self.Domain.Lerp(t.Clamp(0.0, 1.0));
        var step = s / panels.ToNumber;
        var samples = (panels + 1).Range;
        var x = samples.Reduce(0.0, (acc, i) =>
            acc + SimpsonWeight(i, panels) * self.TangentAngleAt(step * i.ToNumber).Cos);
        var y = samples.Reduce(0.0, (acc, i) =>
            acc + SimpsonWeight(i, panels) * self.TangentAngleAt(step * i.ToNumber).Sin);
        return (x * step / 3.0, y * step / 3.0);
    }
```

```plato
    // A conical spiral: the winding radius interpolates across Radii while the
    // curve climbs Height over the full sweep.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conical_spiral
    Eval(self: ConicalSpiral3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(self.Radii.Lerp(t) * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos,
                                 self.Radii.Lerp(t) * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin,
                                 self.Height * t);
```

```plato
    // A spherical spiral (loxodrome): the inclination sweeps a half turn from
    // pole to pole while the azimuth completes TurnCount revolutions.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_spiral
    Eval(self: SphericalSpiral3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Sin * (t * self.TurnCount).Turns.Cos,
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Sin * (t * self.TurnCount).Turns.Sin,
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Cos);
```

## Line 507

```plato

    //==
    // # Knots and classical space curves

    // The (p,q) torus knot: r = MajorRadius + MinorRadius cos(q phi),
    // x = r cos(p phi), y = r sin(p phi), z = -MinorRadius sin(q phi).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_knot
    Eval(self: TorusKnot, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               (self.MajorRadius
                + self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Cos)
               * (t.Turns * self.AxisWindings.ToNumber).Cos,
               (self.MajorRadius
                + self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Cos)
               * (t.Turns * self.AxisWindings.ToNumber).Sin,
               -self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Sin);
```

```plato
    // The trefoil knot in symmetric canonical form:
    // x = sin t + 2 sin 2t, y = cos t - 2 cos 2t, z = -sin 3t.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trefoil_knot
    Eval(self: TrefoilKnot, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               self.Scale * (t.Turns.Sin + 2.0 * (t.Turns * 2.0).Sin),
               self.Scale * (t.Turns.Cos - 2.0 * (t.Turns * 2.0).Cos),
               self.Scale * -(t.Turns * 3.0).Sin);
```

```plato
    // Viviani's curve: x = R(1 + cos t), y = R sin t, z = 2R sin(t / 2).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viviani%27s_curve
    Eval(self: VivianiCurve, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(self.Radius * (1.0 + t.Turns.Cos),
                                 self.Radius * t.Turns.Sin,
                                 2.0 * self.Radius * (t.Turns / 2.0).Sin);
}
```
